name: @ozjsey/write-behind
description: Write-behind cache in plain TypeScript — local state stays authoritative, the server's reply is discarded on purpose, and a slow response can never clear a newer edit
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup writeBehind.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/writeBehind.js dist/writeBehind.min.js && mv dist/writeBehind.js.map dist/writeBehind.min.js.map && mv dist/writeBehind.cjs dist/writeBehind.min.cjs && mv dist/writeBehind.cjs.map dist/writeBehind.min.cjs.map && mv dist/writeBehind.d.cts dist/writeBehind.min.d.cts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['writeBehind.min.js','writeBehind.min.cjs']){const p='dist/'+f;let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=writeBehind\.(js|cjs)\.map/, '//# sourceMappingURL='+f+'.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);}"
